.md): Archive an environment. It stops being selectable for runs and frees its name for a new one, but the row is kept and can be
restored — this is why archive is a sub-action rather than a DELETE. Requires `expectedRevision` — the revision you last read. If
the environment changed since, the write is re…\n- [Restore an archived environment](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/environ
ments/restore-an-archived-environment.md): Restore an archived environment. Returns 409 if another live environment took its name
in the meantime. Plugin pins whose version row no longer exists at all are dropped on the way back to live — compare the returned
`pluginVersionIds` against what you archived to detect that. Requires `expectedRevi…\n- [List a project's scenarios](https://docs.
mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/list-a-projects-scenarios.md): The studies published from this project — name, access mode, attac
hed servers, and share link. Read-only.\n- [Publish an environment for user testing](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies
/publish-an-environment-for-user-testing.md): PUT, not POST, because publishing is IDEMPOTENT: one study per environment, and publ
ishing an already-published environment returns the existing one rather than minting a second. `created` says which happened.\n- [
Unpublish an environment](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/unpublish-an-environment.md): Takes the study down. Delibe
rately NOT behind the beta gate that guards publishing: an organization that loses the flag must still be able to take a live stud
y down.\n- [Get a study](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/get-a-study.md): One study's full read: execution settings
(model, system prompt, tool-approval policy, attached servers, share link), the environment it publishes, and the insights envelop
e over its latest analyzed window.\n- [Update a scenario](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/update-a-scenario.md): Cha
nge a study's identity or its exposure — but not both in one call. **Send `mode` on its own.** Identity and exposure are separate
operations upstream, and applying them in sequence could leave the study live in a mode you did not ask for.\n- [List a scenario's
sessions](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/list-a-scenarios-sessions.md): What visitors did, as summaries. Project m
embers only — this route is deliberately absent from the guest allowlist, so a share-link visitor can never read other visitors' s
essions.\n- [Get a session transcript](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/get-a-session-transcript.md): The projected t
ranscript, paged. Tool payloads and blobs are dropped, and the stored blob URL is never returned.\n- [Set the guest-execution caps
](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/set-the-guest-execution-caps.md): The spend dial for anonymous visitors. A FULL RE
PLACEMENT — send every field. These caps only mean something as a set, and a partial update that raised one while leaving another
stale would produce a combination nobody chose.\n- [Rotate the share link](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/rotate-th
e-share-link.md): Mints a new share link and stops the old URL from granting access. Everyone you shared it with needs the new one
.\n- [Invite a member](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/invite-a-member.md): Upsert by email, so re-inviting somebody
is not an error. Only meaningful while `mode` is `invited_only`.\n- [Remove a member](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studi
es/remove-a-member.md): Removal NARROWS access, so it bumps `accessVersion` and cuts off any session that member already had — it
takes effect at once rather than at expiry.\n- [Point a scenario at a different environment](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference
/studies/point-a-scenario-at-a-different-environment.md): Keeps the study's LINK, its members and its session history while changi
ng what visitors actually reach. The alternative — unpublish and republish — mints a new link, which means re-sharing it with ever
yone.\n- [Session metrics](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/session-metrics.md): Volumes, completion and feedback rat
es over the study's sessions.\n- [Usage breakdown](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/usage-breakdown.md): Which models
, tools and servers the study's sessions used.\n- [Current window signals](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/current-w
indow-signals.md): What the miner extracted from the current window — and where you get the window id the insights read takes.\n-
[List scenario findings](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/list-scenario-findings.md): Every finding raised over this
study's windows, dismissed ones included — dismissal is a state on the finding, not a deletion.\n- [Read a window's insights](http
s://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/read-a-windows-insights.md): Poll this after requesting a generation.\n- [Request insigh
ts for the current window](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/request-insights-for-the-current-window.md): **No credits
are consumed** — the model cost is on MCPJam. Runs a model over the study's current window and draws on the organization's `insig
htsPerDay` ledger, which counts REQUESTS and is SHARED with eval-run and swarm run insights, so a request here takes one from ther
e.\n- [Cancel a window's generation](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/cancel-a-windows-generation.md): Releases a gen
eration that is stuck `pending`. Idempotent against an already-finished one.\n- [Dismiss a finding](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-re
ference/studies/dismiss-a-finding.md): Keyed on the finding's stable remediation id, so the same problem stays dismissed when insi
ghts regenerate. Bodyless: the path names the finding.\n- [Restore a dismissed finding](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/stud
ies/restore-a-dismissed-finding.md): Undoes a dismissal. Bodyless: the path names the finding.\n- [Create (or revive) a relay tunn
el for a named project server](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/tunnels/create-or-revive-a-relay-tunnel-for-a-named-project-s
erver.md): Registers a server record named `name` if missing, mints a relay tunnel grant for it, and **persists the tunnel bearer
URL (including the plaintext `?k=` secret) onto the server record's `url`** so evals and studies can target the tunnel like any re
mote server. The plaintext persistence is a deliber…\n- [Revoke a tunnel's live grant](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/tunne
ls/revoke-a-tunnels-live-grant.md): Revokes the grant at the control plane and edge: the public URL stops working immediately and
any live tunnel session is disconnected. The server record — including its now-dead `url` — is intentionally left untouched, so th
e next create revives the tunnel with the same slug.\n- [List a project's plugins](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/plugins/l
ist-a-projects-plugins.md): The live (installed, non-uninstalled) Agent Plugins in the project, disabled ones included (marked `en
abled: false`). Read-only: import, activation, enable/disable and uninstall are app flows, not API operations.\n- [Get a plugin ve
rsion](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/plugins/get-a-plugin-version.md): One imported plugin version with its component proj
ections: declared MCP servers (placement, auth timing, materialized server id) and declared skills (namespaced model refs). Addres
sed by the version id alone — access is membership of the version's own project, and historical versions of uninstalled…\n- [List
a project's skills](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/skills/list-a-projects-skills.md): The Cloud Skills visible to the calle
r in this project: the project-shared ones plus the caller's own drafts. Each row reports `pinnability`, which is what decides whe
ther its id is usable in an environment's `skillSelection`.\n- [Get a skill](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/skills/get-a-sk
ill.md): One skill, including its SKILL.md body. The body is mutable and an edit overwrites the previous one in place, so `aggrega
teHash` is the only handle on which content this read returned.\n- [Run one headless agent turn](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-refer
ence/agent/run-one-headless-agent-turn.md): Runs ONE assistant turn over the supplied message history and responds synchronously w
ith the final assistant text, the operations it invoked, references to any resources it created, and any actions awaiting human ap
